segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Hi everyone, thanks for making time. This is the kickoff for Brightwell's onboarding. I'm Owen, and Maya is your implementation lead.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Great to meet you, Tobias. Today we'll cover timelines, the data import, and who your admins will be.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: Sounds good. We're excited to get off the spreadsheets, honestly.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: That's what we like to hear. For the import, we'll need a CSV export of your current patient scheduling templates, no patient data, just the templates.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: That's easy. Our operations manager can send that this week.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: For admins, we recommend two people per clinic so there's coverage for vacations.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: We have six clinics, so twelve admins. I'll send you the list.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Perfect. After that, we'll run a pilot at one clinic for two weeks before rolling out to the rest.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: Can the pilot be at the Westside location? They're the most organized.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Absolutely. We'll schedule admin training for the week of the twentieth.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: And you'll have a shared Slack channel with our team for questions during the pilot.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: That's great. I think that covers everything from my side.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Wonderful. Thanks, Tobias, we'll send a recap with next steps this afternoon. Bye for now.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: Thanks, bye everyone.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Okay, he's gone. Is the recording still on? Whatever. Did you end up going to that wedding in Napa this weekend?

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: I did, and it was a disaster. My ex was there with his new girlfriend, and someone sat us at the same table.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: No. What did you do?

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Drank too much rosé and left before the cake. My mom keeps texting me asking if I'm okay.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Honestly that's the right call. Want to get drinks Thursday and debrief properly?

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Yes please. I'll text you after my therapy appointment.
